incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-gateway | condition=5xx_rate > 7% over 5m | alert_id=PD-INC-86021 | severity=P1 | region=us-west-2 | link=https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-INC-86021 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty auto-page sent to @sophie (oncall) -> acknowledgment pending. Escalation policy: 2m -> oncall-sre -> 10m -> eng-sre.
sophie (oncall): taking this. acknowledging in PD now. ping me with short impact summary pls.
carlos: seeing the spike on grafana: inference-gateway 5xx spike started ~ 6832109600, cluster-wide. error breakdown looks like 502/504 from edge -> upstream timeouts.
sophie (oncall): thanks @carlos. are any customers reporting errors in the last 30m? sales/customer-success?
maria: quick check in intercom - one enterprise customer (acct: AcmeCorp) reported timeouts for embed requests ~5m ago. no broader tickets yet.
jason: looking at access logs, increased upstream latency to model-backend-1, high tail latencies and retries. appears correlated with a new rollout lane (canary) from 30m ago.
sophie (oncall): okay immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop canary / rollback lane, 2) ramp extra capacity on dedicated pool if needed, 3) add temporary routing fallback -> graylist canary traffic, 4) warm KV cache. who can do 1 and 3?
carlos: I can flip the rollout to pause. doing: `ksctl rollout pause inference-model/canary-lane`
ops-bot: Command executed: `ksctl rollout pause inference-model/canary-lane` -> success.
jason: disabling canary routing at the gateway: editing route-weight: `curl -XPATCH https://cfg.api/internal/routes/inference -d '{"canary_weight":0}'` (will push in 2s).
ops-bot: Gateway route update pushed, canary weight -> 0%. Confirming: proxy now routing 100% to stable variant.
maria: monitoring customer errors - AcmeCorp errors dropping slightly but still seeing a smattering of 502s.
sophie (oncall): could be cached KV churn. try warming cache on stable variant and increase retry budget to avoid cascading. Carlos/Jason can you trigger cache prewarm? give command snippet.
carlos: running cache warmup job against stable: ```kubectl run kv-warmup --image=redwood/kv-warmup:prod -- /warmup --targets=inference-stable --batch=200```
ops-bot: Job kv-warmup started in namespace prod. Logs streaming -> `warming shard 1/12 ...`
jason: also increased model-backend connection pool size from 50 -> 80 on the inference pool via infra toggle `INF_CONN_POOL=80` (applied).
sophie (oncall): good. shifting throttles: lower non-critical burst limits to protect model-backend. Applying temporary rate limit at gateway: `limit: global_rps=12000 -> 9000`
ops-bot: Rate limit change applied. Observability: dashboards show 5xx rate trending down from 9% -> 4% in last 90s.
maria: customer FYI: queued a low-urgency note to AcmeCorp support that we saw transient errors and are mitigating. no SLA breach yet.
carlos: logs show remaining 502s are from a small set of IPs with high retry churn; will blacklist noisy clients for 5m.
jason: suggestion: set fallback-model variant with lower latency (quantized) for burst traffic -> feature flagging now.
sophie (oncall): don't flip model variants until we confirm stability. current plan: 1) pause canary (done), 2) warm caches (in progress), 3) temporary rate limits (done), 4) throttle noisy clients (doing). If 5xx < 1% for 5m, close PD.
ops-bot: Blacklist applied for noisy IPs -> ttl=300s.
maria: Grafana alert: downstream service model-backend-1 latency normalized; 95p dropped from 1.8s -> 0.34s.
sophie (oncall): good. starting timeline note for post-incident: root cause suspected canary rollout caused backend saturation due to incompatible client retries -> causing upstream timeouts. will open incident ticket and assign follow-ups.
carlos: opening incident issue RD-86021 with actions: postmortem, rollout gating, better canary circuit breaker.
ops-bot: Issue RD-86021 created: https://tickets.example.com/RD-86021
sophie (oncall): handing off to @jason for 30m follow-up checks; I'll remain reachable for escalation. next oncall in 31m is @maria. Handoff summary: mitigation applied, 5xx rate dropped to ~0.5% last 5m, primary action: paused canary + cache warm + rate limit + IP throttle.
jason: ack, will monitor for 30m and update status.
maria: ack, will take over if needed.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-86021 updated: status=acknowledged -> mitigated; responders: sophie,jason,carlos.
sophie (oncall): closing Slack thread. follow-up: write blameless postmortem, add canary throttling + circuit breaker, improve PD runbook for similar 5xx patterns. :white_check_mark:
